Gains Temporary Hit Points at the start of each of their turns.
Rises after death at half maximum hit points with Action Surge.
Bleeds in combat at the start of each turn and when the Stigma is applied.

Utter a secret prayer and place the Stigma of Communion on an ally - at the start of each of their turns they gain [1] Temporary Hit Points. If already under a Stigma - Blessed for [2] turns instead.
One such Stigma at a time. Cannot target self.

Resistant to physical damage.
The bones grow heavy: movement speed is reduced by [1].
Rises after death at half maximum hit points with Action Surge.
Bleeds in combat at the start of each turn and when the Stigma is applied.

Utter a secret prayer and place the Stigma of the Bone on an ally or yourself - target becomes resistant to physical damage, their movement speed is reduced by [2], and all incoming damage is reduced by [1].
One such Stigma at a time.

Only the artefact's Prayer requires walking the path of Ilmater; the artefact's other gifts serve all who wear it. To walk the path: socket the Stoic Runic Shard, play a Cleric or Paladin of Ilmater, or use a mod that adds the Crying God's worship.
You bear the suffering of those you have blessed with stigmata. While above 50% HP, you are Vulnerable to physical damage. Ilmater's grace flows through pain, not pride.
Your first prayer of the fight costs no Action.
While your hit points are below [2]%, you are immune to [1].
The first time you are afflicted with Bleeding in combat, you are wrapped in Veil for [1] turns or until your first attack.
